messages:
sales_jen: Hey team, GateHouse POC seeing intermittent slow first byte (~1.2s) and occasional 503s during spike tests. They're evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted and want cost impact if we change batching/prefill. Can we swarm?
ram_engineer: joining. Any request IDs or logs from the window?
mike_sre: saw alerts; looks like queueing at the gateway. Batching window could be increasing latency at low QPS.
sales_jen: pasted logs from 21:03-21:10 UTC (EU region):
``
2026-02-18T21:04:12Z request_id=gh-9b2 status=200 latency_ms=1240 model=rwl-13b
2026-02-18T21:04:13Z request_id=gh-9b3 status=503 error="shard-queue-full" backend=gpu-pool-7
2026-02-18T21:04:15Z request_id=gh-9b4 status=200 latency_ms=1100 model=rwl-13b
```
ops_amit: shard-queue-full => model shard queue hit concurrency threshold and dropped requests. Hosted falls back to 503 when queue > throttle.
ram_engineer: are they using streaming? That holds worker slots longer.
sales_jen: streaming disabled. Client often sends long context (~8k tokens).
mike_sre: options: 1) reduce per-request GPU time (max_tokens, smaller model, quantized variant) 2) adjust batching/window on their route to favor TTFT (lower batch_wait_ms).
ram_engineer: I'll push a canary override: batch_window_ms=10, max_batch_size=8, prefill_kv=true for route gatehouse-prod-poc. That should reduce queueing but raise per-token cost.
sre-bot: deploy job 4821 started by ram_engineer.
ram_engineer: canary deployed. Run the same load?
sales_jen: running 200 concurrent users for 2m.
mike_sre: tailing logs: queue depth down, 503s dropped. TTFT median improved ~1.2s -> 420ms for short contexts; 8k contexts still ~900ms.
sales_jen: client confirms fewer 503s but concerned about cost.
mike_sre: Dedicated avoids noisy neighbor, pinned GPUs, stable latency without lowering batching. Higher fixed cost but lower per-token for sustained throughput. Hosted with reduced batching -> faster TTFT, higher per-token.
ram_engineer: quick estimate: token-cost ~4.8x while canary active for these short runs. I'll export billing sim.
sales_jen: also they submitted security questionnaire about route isolation & data retention.
mike_sre: note: prefill (automated) is an enterprise add-on on Hosted and included for Dedicated. For POC we can run manual warmup prior to demo to reduce KV cache misses.
sales_jen: client accepted manual warmup for next demo.
mike_sre: I'll produce cost vs latency numbers and attach traces. Ram, please collect model:latency histograms and queue_depth traces for the test window.
ram_engineer: traces uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drive/gatehouse-poc/traces-20260218
sales_jen: thanks. I'll send summary: manual warmup + canary batching override (cost delta) + Dedicated sizing as optional. :thumbsup:
ram_engineer: marking resolved; reopen if regressions.
sre-bot: alert resolved: gateway-route/gatehouse-prod-poc queue-high -> cleared
